title: POST /api/hackatime/v1/users/:id/heartbeats.bulk, 201
description: HackatimeController#push_heartbeats with the bulk format (hackatime_controller.rb lines 59-67): one entry per heartbeat sent, in the order sent, so one bad heartbeat doesn't refuse the rest (lines 284-290). An entry is a pair, the stored row (heartbeat.schema.json) and 201, or the refusal (heartbeat_error.schema.json) and 422 (lines 227-239). A heartbeat whose fields_hash a row already has gets that row and 201, as a new one does, so a client's replay of its offline queue is answered like the first send (heartbeat_ingest.rb lines 70-82). The keywords check.py and internal/jsonschema share can't pin an array's elements by position, so here an entry is two elements, one object and one status, and the two body schemas pin the rest. An empty array, or one over MAX_BULK_HEARTBEATS = 100, is refused whole with 400 (lines 61-65).
